title: NNSA FOIA response on Starfish Prime UAP records
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NNSA FOIA response on Starfish Prime UAP records, about 1962; FOIA recent at United States, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a guy who used the Freedom of Information Act to request all records of UAV, UAP, UFO, any acronym related to UFO from the Starfish Prime series.
